title: A Properly Evil Performance
description: The instruments are assembled. Strike up the first performance under Quaver's direction. These are live instrument-use objectives: possession alone cannot complete the finale.
description_completed: Music has returned to the Dark Tower. Quaver has a band, the court has a soundtrack, and none of this is required for formal Tower Restoration.
